messages:
lara (PM): Proposal: staggered proxy fallback for model routing to limit cost spikes during rollout. Keep canary + small A/B for quality.
jon (eng): Outline the slices and concrete fallback order?
lara (PM): Slices: 1) 0.25% EU (24h), 2) 2% EU+NA (48h), 3) 12% global with 8% active / 4% shadow A/B (5d), final ramp to 100% if stable. Fallback order: tenant-dedicated -> smaller quantized model -> cached response.
sam (sre): Circuit-breakers: sliding 60s. Trip if p95>250ms OR errors>1.2% OR cost/slice > +15% for 10m. If tripped, auto switch to model-level fallback for that slice and page after 5m.
maya (data): For A/B we'll track eval-lift, automated eval set + 150 human blind checks/day, token-efficiency, and downstream click proxy. Will create dashboard and thresholds.
jon (eng): Flag name: ff.proxy-fallback-v1. Config stored in Launchpad. Add telemetry tags: rollout_id, slice, ab_group, fallback_code.
lara (PM): Important: have small exempt list for 3 enterprise tenants (manual opt-in). Legal and CS need to sign off; they won't be auto-fallbacked.
sam (sre): Ops runbook short: check slice-specific dashboard, force fallback flag for slice if triggered, if repeated breaches pause rollout and escalate to PM+eng. Manual rollback needs 2 approvers.
ops-bot: INFO: flag ff.proxy-fallback-v1 enabled at 1718000050 (slice=0.25% EU). Monitor /dashboards/proxy-fallback-canary
jon (eng): Dev tasks: rollout automation, unit tests for routing policies, shadow join infra, automated rollback playbook. I'll open PRs and link here.
lara (PM): I'll draft the playbook, add CS notes and opt-in form. Team, please review and confirm readiness before promoting to 2% stage. Thanks!
